create_rich_progress_reporter: create a RichProgressReporter with a console to display progress bars for tasks
create_progress_task: create a progress task with a name and total using RichProgressReporter.create_task
get_console: get the default Rich Console instance for printing formatted output
get_error_console: get the default Rich error Console instance for printing to stderr
create_basic_mofn_column: create a BasicMofNCompleteColumn ProgressColumn to render completed over total counts
